_comment: Copy to scripts/models.json and fill in real photos. Aim for a roster that spans skin tones, ages, body types and genders so the generated rack previews read as diverse. `photo` is a project-relative path (e.g. scripts/models/aisha.jpg) or an https URL to a clear, front-facing, full-or-upper-body shot on a plain background.

overrides._comment: Optional: pin a specific model to a specific outfit id.
